validation.detail: C124 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 原 RGB()/BtnA 经 GPIO41 和 GPIO35 RMT 完成双色/释放闭环，无 LCD。固件关闭 UART REPL，测试 boot 通过真实 UART0 dupterm 输出日志；USB CDC、IR、网络和物理光度未验证。

blockers: Selected exact-firmware native behavior passed; full peripheral completion, arbitrary firmware, networking and physical equivalence are not established. See device-local evidence and remaining component blockers.
